purpose: Express a wish to perform an action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
ます-stem + たい; conjugates like an い-adjective.
I want to go to Japan.
What would you like to eat?
I do not want to go outside today.
formation: ます-stem + たい; conjugates like an い-adjective.
restrictions: Direct assertions usually concern the speaker; ask or qualify when referring to others.
mistake: たい changes to たくない for a negative wish.
